summary: The Backrooms is a multiplayer survival RPG whose persistent player state carries progression through authored and simulation-built levels. Shared player, NPC, combat, appearance and presentation systems serve the levels; fresh visits open a title over the live halls, then route character creation through a separate 2000s bedroom and a local noclip intro into Level 0.
places: places/main (3D) - Level 0 / The Lobby, yellow maze and safe-room hub; authored fixtures, shifting-wall moments, hunters and lore props.
places/intake (3D) - standalone 2000s bedroom character-creation room; authored scene props plus scripts/intake-geo.js room shell.
places/level1, places/level2, places/level21 (3D) - Habitable Zone, Pipe Dreams and Locked; authored spaces plus Level 2.1 simulated rooms, zones and agents.
places/level3, places/gamma, places/level4, places/level5 (3D) - Electrical Station, Base Gamma, Abandoned Office and Terror Hotel; residents, hazards and Boiler Room Death Rats.
places/level6, places/level61, places/level7, places/level8 (3D) - Lights Out, Snackrooms, ocean/Seawatch and Fort Surrender; food-court services, camps, caves and traders.
places/level10 (3D, Bumper Crop) - heightmapped farm, Outpost Bountiful, quests, lake fishing and exits toward Level 7 and Level 11.
places/level11 (3D) - Infinite City generated districts, canal, shops, Realty, old-town tram street and U.E.C. Thebes checkpoint.
places/home11, places/debug, places/spamton and other numbered places - persistent furnished home, debug test room, basement showroom/boss arena and separately configured levels.
roots: world.config.yaml - multiplayer entry at main; declares player actions, camera, player template/HUD, routing, player cap and Backspace menu action.
templates/player.js + templates/camera.js; scripts/camera.js - ordered player behavior and camera entry; view3 supplies third-person mode.
places/<place>/config.yaml + cells + sim.js - place setup and placements; sims build local layouts and tick local behavior.
sim.js - world cadence and out-of-bounds handling: players respawn, creatures with state.home return, other creatures are destroyed for manager respawn.
scripts/main-menu.js + scripts/main-menu-ui.js - local title/pause behavior, title music and menu UI; START routes into intake.

places/intake/cells/x0z0.scene + scripts/intake-geo.js - bedroom fixtures and scripted room shell; scripts/lib/intro-cut.js stages the post-creator noclip scene and scripts/cutscene-ui.js draws its letterbox/fades.
places/level11/sim.js + scripts/lib/level11-city.js - generated city/street assembly, old-town detail, shops, Realty, house exterior and Thebes.
places/home11/sim.js + scripts/home11-door.js - versioned interior builder/restoration and home exit, doors, storage and furnishings.
shared: scripts/lib/maze.js, level1.js, level2.js, level21.js through level7.js + data - per-level grids, zones, layouts and paths reused by sims, geometry, labels and navigation.
scripts/lib/level-kit.js + scripts/lib/npc-respawn.js - named-person management, throttling and shared NPC return timing for place sims.
scripts/lib/clothes.js + scripts/lib/data/clothes.yml - garment tokens, armor/clothing operations and deterministic NPC wardrobe/body rolls; used by player, NPC and wardrobe systems.
scripts/lib/critter-model.js + critter/clothes/faces data - shared species body/head/face/garment rendering and facial morphs for the creator and NPCs.
scripts/lib/loot.js + scripts/lib/items.js + level data - shared item pools, rolls, remains, parsing and container helpers.
scripts/lib/combat.js + combat.yml + scripts/lib/ballistics.js - shared hit/armor and firearm accuracy/projectile rules for player and NPC combat.
scripts/lib/nav.js + builtin/nav; scripts/lib/footsteps.js + footsteps.yml - shared NPC path search and surface-clip selection; scripts/lib/photo2006.js supplies photographic finishing.

scripts/lib/level8-quests.js, level10-quests.js, level11-quests.js and level21-quests.js - dialogue quest definitions, player-step/HUD updates and completion rewards; scripts/talk.js dispatches handlers.
notableExports: sim.js - cadence, tick, onOutOfBounds; places/level21/sim.js and places/level61/sim.js - cadence, tick; places/level11/sim.js - cadence, L11_FAR, l11Lean, tick.
places/home11/sim.js - cadence, tick; scripts/home11-door.js - ding and ears.press; scripts/grab.js - setDown, onInput, update; scripts/build.js - onInput, update.
scripts/lib/level8-quests.js and level21-quests.js - quest definitions, setters, finishers and dialogue handlers; level10-quests.js and level11-quests.js - corresponding quest APIs.
scripts/lib/fishing.js - water checks, fishing lifecycle and loot helpers; scripts/bobber.js - spawn, schedule, update, cleanup.
scripts/player.js - player combat/progression/input and fishing handlers; scripts/lib/body3.js - swing3, fire3, stance.
scripts/lib/level11-city.js - layCity, layStreet, tickCity; scripts/lib/level11-shop.js - SHOP, layShop; scripts/lib/level11-elevator.js - elevator schedule/call/ears/update.
scripts/main-menu.js - update, onInput; scripts/main-menu-ui.js - mainMenu; scripts/intake-geo.js - geometry; scripts/wardrobe-ui.js - wardrobe.

scripts/cutscene-ui.js - cutUi; scripts/lib/intro-cut.js - cutTick; scripts/lib/clothes.js - fullLook, cloth token/wear/armor helpers, npcLook, plainLook; scripts/lib/critter-model.js - bodyModel, headModel, faceFill, faceMorph, critterSpec and rig/model helpers.
ownership: scripts/player.js - persistent player.state progression, health/sanity, inventory/equipment/ammo/condition, needs, money, visits, combat/rewards, appearance, karma/rep and level access.
scripts/grab.js - player carry/carryId/carryMul and session held-object state; strength, load, health and stamina limit lifting.
scripts/lib/fishing.js - player.state.fishingState session and canonical water checks, bite/reel outcome and location-based loot; scripts/bobber.js owns spawned float/session state.
scripts/stats.js + scripts/lib/stats.js - HALOGEN attributes, skills, points, tags and sheet state; scripts/craft.js owns craft actions and costs/outputs.
scripts/interact.js + scripts/lib/seat.js - focus, loot and sit state; interact.js persists configured storage contents to player.state[saveKey].
scripts/talk.js owns dialogue/shop UI, rapport/trade/rep and authored-choice effects; quest libraries own quest keys/HUD/payout; scripts/l8-use.js owns Level 8 interaction flags.

scripts/main-menu.js - player menu/intake/intro state transitions (menuOpen, menuKind, madeChar, cut, introFrom) and local session camera/music/cutscene state; scripts/critter.js updates creator look/outfits.
places/home11/sim.js owns builtV and live fridge/tote/moved state; scripts/build.js writes player.state.homeKeep.built and home11-door.js/grab.js mirror home furnishings.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js ordered behaviors: locomotion/player, swim, interact/grab/rest/mahjong/talk/build/stats/craft/OS/lockpick/spamton-fight/horde, then critter, main-menu and view3; routing is configured there.
world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js; view3 writes player.state.tp/orbit → third-person camera; camera writes player.state.aimPt → player.js crosshair-aligned shots.

Fresh visit → scripts/main-menu.js sets menuOpen/menuKind=title and local hall camera/music; START via scripts/main-menu-ui.js records introFrom and crosses to intake; Backspace opens pause and RESUME closes it.

Arrival in places/intake → scripts/main-menu.js opens wardrobe creator; closing it sets madeChar and state.cut, then scripts/lib/intro-cut.js walks the player to the bedroom wall and locally stages the yellow-paper noclip scene.

scripts/lib/intro-cut.js writes player pose/animation, local wall patch/FX, view camera and timed audio/screen effects; scripts/ui.js renders scripts/cutscene-ui.js when state.cut is set, whose letterbox/fades/subtitle timing is keyed to that timestamp.
At the end of the ~25 s intro, intro-cut clears cutscene effects/state and returns true → main-menu.js crosses to places/main; scripts/noclip.js handles the Level 0 arrival fall.
scripts/main-menu.js local title/intake state → scripts/player.js suppresses weapon hands; menu and intake/cutscene cameras are local, while title theme is a local session audio object.
Spawn room selection → scripts/routing.js pickRoom preserves accepted requestedRoomId or derives solo room from user identity; engine out-of-bounds → sim.js handles respawn/return/destruction.

Level threshold trigger → scripts/level-door.js maps paired IDs and writes arrival clipKind/calls companion.bring → followers cross; player.js consumes clipKind to xfer.kind and noclip-ui renders transition.
places/level10/sim.js → terrain-relative farm, NPCs and usable props; scripts/level10-use.js ears.press updates harvesting, crafting/resources and quest state.
Level 7/10/11 rod casts: scripts/player.js → scripts/lib/fishing.js validates place-specific water, spawns scripts/bobber.js and stores fishingState → scheduled handlers resolve catches.

NPC dialogue: scripts/lib/npc-starters.js supplies authored choices → scripts/talk.js matches them, rolls optional skill checks and applies reply/heal/recruit/discount effects; unmatched text goes to the LLM path. talk.js dispatches Level 11/10/8/21 quest handlers → quest flags/HUD, notices/feed and rewards; Level 8 turn-ins read l8-use flags, while Level 11 Realty dialogue writes home11.
behaviorFamilies: places/main/cells/* and places/level5/cells/* - authored fixtures with local sound/light and red-zone variants; Level 5 has portal/quest props and scripts/l5-rats.js Boiler Room Death Rat packs.
places/level4/cells/x0z0.scene + Level 4 geometry/detail/prop/look and scripts/l4-office.js/l4-office-geo.js/l4-home.js - office layout, fixture variants, resident schedules and home claims.

scripts/lib/l4-people.js + level4-people.yml and scripts/lib/l5-people.js + level5-people.yml - NPC roles, dialogue, looks and routines vary by person; meg-agent.js supplies shared combat/social behavior.
scripts/lib/craft.js + scripts/lib/data/craft.yml - recipes vary by category, cost, skill, bench and output; canonical weapon IDs connect crafting to equip/combat/condition.
places/level21/sim.js + level21.yml + level21-geo.js - shared room blocks vary by room type, zone height, lighting, decor and deterministic layout hashes.
places/level61/sim.js + scripts/lib/level61-extra.js + l61-use/staff/diner/jukebox scripts - food-court venues share service systems with varying menus and Faceling roles.

scripts/lib/level11-city.js + level11-models.yml + art/level11 kits - generated buildings/props vary by seeded district, model and placement; the sim adds old-town tram, gable advert and open unfinished office details.

scripts/lib/clothes.js + scripts/lib/critter-model.js + critter/faces/clothes data - player and NPC looks share species/body/garment construction; seeded NPC wardrobe, sex/species and role-weighted resting traits vary by identity and role.
migrationNotes: Title START enters places/intake; closing wardrobe starts the ~25 s local intro and always crosses to places/main (introFrom records the source but is not used as the return destination). Keep creator/menu state transitions aligned.

The intro depends on places/intake back-wall geometry: WALL=(1.0,2.5), STAND=(1.0,1.95), and its staged camera/hand effects use the same wall coordinates; scripts/noclip.js owns the subsequent Level 0 fall.
Level 2.1 grid is 30×30 at 4 m per cell; keep level21.js passability/room zones, maze21path.js traversal, sim geometry/hound routing aligned, and roofAt in place state across ticks.
Paired transitions (Level 2.1↔2, 6↔6.1, 6.1↔11, 10↔11) are owned by level-door.js; Level 10 lake-deep trigger targets level7#l7-from-l10.

Level 10/184 use terrain10.js/terrain184.js heightmap/material queries; keep y placements and arrival/track regions aligned. Fishing uses world-space positions and place-specific water regions/surface heights.

Level 11 city sim V=95 rebuilds open-room features; model axes, measured scales and placements live across level11-models.yml and sim.js. Canal bridges, quay coping and shop interior collision geometry are coupled to street placement; NPC clothing/face variation is identity-seeded, so preserve authored look fields and role/species mappings.
